test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive form.

The shopkeeper lifted the shutter to open his shop.

options.text: To open his shop, the shutter is lifted by the shopkeeper.
The shutter will be lifted by the shopkeeper to open his shop.
The shutter was lifted by the shopkeeper to open his shop.
The shutter is being lifted by the shopkeeper to open his shop.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The shopkeeper lifted the shutter to open his shop."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the shutter" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "lifted" to "was lifted" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the shopkeeper."
 
• Ensure the purpose "to open his shop" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The shutter was lifted by the shopkeeper to open his shop."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"To open his shop, the shutter is lifted by the shopkeeper." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The shutter will be lifted by the shopkeeper to open his shop." – Incorrect tense (future simple passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The shutter is being lifted by the shopkeeper to open his shop." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
